description: This PHP source file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) class 'ReportingMethodConfigurationDao' for managing reporting methods within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, searching, pagination, and validation related to 'ReportingMethod' entities.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDao
classes.description: A DAO class for handling database operations related to 'ReportingMethod' entities, such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and checking existence.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Persists a ReportingMethod entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Finds a ReportingMethod entity by its name, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getReportingMethodListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of ReportingMethod entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ReportingMethod entities matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Returns a list of ReportingMethod entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes reporting methods with specified IDs and returns the number of deletions.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a reporting method with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns an array of reporting method IDs that are currently in use in the 'ReportTo' relationships.
